map.异或加密，密钥循环使用，加密解密同一操作。: XOR cipher with a cyclically reused key; encryption and decryption are the same operation.
map.；再次异或同一密钥即可还原，加密与解密是同一操作。: ; XOR with the same key again restores it — encryption and decryption are the same operation.
map.：单字节密钥极易被频率分析破解；重复使用的多字节密钥可被重合指数攻击。: : a single-byte key is trivially broken by frequency analysis; a reused multi-byte key is vulnerable to index-of-coincidence attacks.
map.：一次性密码本——密钥长度不短于明文、完全随机且只用一次。: : one-time pad — key length not shorter than plaintext, fully random, used once.
map.：仅适合教学与轻度混淆，不能用于保护真实机密数据。: : only suitable for teaching and light obfuscation, not for protecting real secrets.
map.按字节与密钥异或的对称流密码，密钥复用等同一次性密码本才安全。: A symmetric stream cipher that XORs each byte with the key; key reuse is safe only as a one-time pad.
map.演示流密码的基本原理：理解为何「密钥长度等于明文且只用一次」才安全，以及复用密钥: Demonstrate the basic principle of stream ciphers: understand why "key length equals plaintext and used once" is required for safety, and why reusing the key is breakable.
map.XOR 为什么不能单独用于保密？: Why can't XOR alone be used for confidentiality?
map.若密钥短且复用，可被频分析与已知明文攻破。: If the key is short and reused, it is breakable by frequency analysis and known-plaintext attacks.
map.复用密钥会被怎么破解？: How is a reused key broken?
map.因为异或可消去：C1 ⊕ C2 = (P1 ⊕ K) ⊕ (P2 ⊕ K) =: Because XOR cancels: C1 ⊕ C2 = (P1 ⊕ K) ⊕ (P2 ⊕ K) = P1 ⊕ P2, the key is completely eliminated. An attacker XORs two ciphertexts and, using natural-language statistics (like spaces and common letter pairs), gradually recovers the plaintext. This is exactly why many historical "one-time pad reused" leaks happened.
